**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH+Alexa Fluor, NPY+Alexa Fluor, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically designed for the optical clearing of intact, highly calcified bone tissues (such as femur, tibia, and skull) and their lipid-rich bone marrow. It incorporates an essential EDTA decalcification step that preserves the structural integrity of the bone marrow cavity while allowing deep penetration of macromolecules. TH and NPY specifically label the catecholaminergic and peptidergic sympathetic nerve terminals, respectively. CD31 and DAPI serve as auxiliary channels to map the vasculature, endosteum contours, and hematopoietic cell clusters, perfectly fulfilling the spatial quantification and microenvironment mapping requirements of the scientific problem.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4) with daily solution changes to remove calcium phosphate from the bone matrix. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 14 days)

2 Washing and Permeabilization
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 20% vol/vol DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine in 1x PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 10% vol/vol DMSO, and 6% vol/vol normal donkey serum in 1x PBS) to prevent non-specific antibody binding. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Immunostaining
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (anti-TH, anti-NPY, anti-CD31 (PECAM1)) diluted in staining buffer (0.2% vol/vol Tween-20, 5% vol/vol DMSO, 3% vol/vol normal donkey serum, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1x PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.2 Wash with washing buffer (0.2% vol/vol Tween-20 and 10 µg/mL heparin in 1x PBS, PTwH) with solution changes every 4-6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor series) and DAPI diluted in staining buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.4 Wash with washing buffer (PTwH) with solution changes every 4-6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Dehydration
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6 Delipidation and Refractive Index Matching
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI = 1.56) until the bone and bone marrow become completely transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
6.3 Store in fresh DBE in a dark, glass vial prior to light-sheet or confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Ongoing)

PGP9.5 is a robust pan-neuronal marker to visualize nerve trunks and fine branches, while Pan-Cytokeratin specifically labels the pancreatic tumor epithelium to clearly define tumor boundaries for assessing perineural invasion (PNI). 1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.7 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol) for bleaching. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.9 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.10 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.11 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.12 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.13 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.14 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.15 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.16 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (PGP9.5 and Pan-Cytokeratin) diluted in PTwH buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 10 μg/ml heparin in PBS) containing 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)

3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.10 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI = 1.56) for refractive index matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Storage and Pre-imaging
4.1 Store the cleared sample in 100% DBE in a dark, airtight glass vial. (Temperature: RT, Time: Long-term)
4.2 Mount the sample in a glass or solvent-resistant imaging chamber filled with 100% DBE prior to 3D light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: As needed)

我在进行胰腺肿瘤神经浸润研究时发现，神经纤维标记信号很弱，且肿瘤与正常组织边界不清晰。此前使用 PEGASOS protocol，但 delipidation 只进行了 24 小时，并且没有进行 decoloration 步骤。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合胰腺肿瘤组织的充分脱脂、脱色/降背景、深层抗体渗透、泛神经与交感神经双信号检测、肿瘤边界辅助判读和三维 PNI 分析。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor, TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) + Alexa Fluor, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for large, dense, and lipid-rich tissues like 12×8×5 mm pancreatic tumors. Its methanol and dichloromethane (DCM) based dehydration and delipidation are far more aggressive and thorough than the previously used PEGASOS method, ensuring deep antibody penetration and high transparency. Crucially, iDISCO+ includes a dedicated 5% H2O2/methanol decoloration step to eliminate tissue pigmentation and autofluorescence, significantly improving the signal-to-noise ratio for weak nerve fibers. The combination of PGP9.5 (pan-nerve), TH (sympathetic nerve), and Pan-Cytokeratin (epithelial tumor boundary) perfectly meets the requirement for 3D PNI analysis without introducing off-list markers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Decoloration
1.1 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.8 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes 100% methanol) for decoloration and bleaching. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.10 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.11 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.12 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.13 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.14 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.15 Wash with PTx.2 (1x PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (1x PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (1x PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% normal donkey serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (PGP9.5, TH (酪氨酸羟化酶), Pan-Cytokeratin) diluted in PTwH (1x PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 µg/mL heparin) supplemented with 5% DMSO and 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
3.2 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 16 hours)
3.7 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor series) and DAPI diluted in PTwH supplemented with 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
3.8 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.9 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.10 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.11 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.12 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 16 hours)

4 Tissue Optical Clearing (Dehydration, Delipidation, and RI Matching)
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol for initial delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for thorough delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
4.10 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Di-benzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching until the tissue becomes completely transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.11 Store the cleared sample in fresh 100% DBE in a dark, airtight container prior to light-sheet or confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash the fixed glioma tissue with PBS to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, 3 changes)

2.1 Incubation with primary antibody CD31 (PECAM1) diluted in blocking buffer (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 5% normal donkey serum) to label structural endothelium. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
2.2 Wash with washing buffer (PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, 5 changes)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
2.4 Wash with washing buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, 5 changes)

3 Dehydration
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF (Tetrahydrofuran) in distilled water, pH adjusted to 9.0 with triethylamine. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water, pH adjusted to 9.0 with triethylamine. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water, pH adjusted to 9.0 with triethylamine. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method highly effective for whole mouse brains. It exceptionally preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins (tdTomato/RFP) while providing high tissue transparency. It is fully compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling, allowing the use of Pan-Cytokeratin to verify the epithelial identity of breast cancer metastases (distinguishing them from brain background) and DAPI for nuclear context, fulfilling all scientific objectives.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash the fixed whole brain tissue with PBS to remove excess fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
1.3 Refresh with new CUBIC-L solution and continue incubation until the brain becomes translucent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
1.4 Wash the sample with PBS thoroughly to remove CUBIC-L with multiple changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody against Pan-Cytokeratin diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
2.3 Wash the sample with washing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) with multiple changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Alexa Fluor-conjugated secondary antibody and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
2.5 Wash the sample with washing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) with multiple changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Post-fixation
3.1 Incubation with 1% PFA in PBS to crosslink the bound antibodies and preserve fluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor, CD31+Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method that excellently preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins (tdTomato/RFP), which is mandatory for this study to locate metastatic cells as the primary channel. It provides highly efficient delipidation for intact adult mouse brains (12×8×6 mm), enabling deep-tissue penetration for whole-brain immunostaining. Pan-Cytokeratin is selected to robustly verify the epithelial identity of the breast cancer metastases, while CD31 is included to label the vasculature, directly addressing the scientific goal of analyzing the spatial distribution of metastases in perivascular areas.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with PBS to wash out excess fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
1.3 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-L solution with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

2 Washing
2.1 Incubation with PBS to remove CUBIC-L reagents. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.2 Incubation with fresh PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.3 Incubation with fresh PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 16 hours)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (Anti-Pan-Cytokeratin and Anti-CD31) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Incubation with washing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.4 Incubation with fresh washing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.5 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor dyes of different wavelengths) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.6 Incubation with washing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.7 Incubation with fresh washing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Post-fixation
4.1 Incubation with 1% PFA in PBS to crosslink bound antibodies. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with PBS to wash out PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R+ solution (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5% N-butyldiethanolamine in water) diluted in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

6 Storage and Pre-imaging

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH + Alexa Fluor, CGRP + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for intact mineralized hard tissues like the mouse femur. It integrates an essential EDTA-based decalcification step with robust delipidation and permeabilization, allowing deep penetration of TH and CGRP antibodies into the bone marrow, endosteum, and periosteum. The THF/DBE-based clearing provides excellent refractive index matching (RI ≈ 1.56) for high-resolution 3D imaging of the neurovascular microenvironment while preserving Alexa Fluor fluorescence.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4) with continuous shaking, replacing the solution daily. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 14 days)

2 Washing
2.1 Wash with 1× PBS with shaking, replacing the buffer every 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3 Permeabilization and Blocking
3.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 20% vol/vol DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 10% vol/vol DMSO, 6% vol/vol normal donkey serum in 1× PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Immunostaining
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (Anti-TH and Anti-CGRP) diluted in PTwH buffer (1× PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Tween-20 and 10 µg/mL heparin) supplemented with 5% vol/vol DMSO and 3% vol/vol normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
4.2 Wash with PTwH buffer, replacing the buffer every 4-6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor series) and DAPI diluted in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% vol/vol normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
4.4 Wash with PTwH buffer, replacing the buffer every 4-6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Dehydration
5.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
5.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6 Delipidation and Refractive Index (RI) Matching
6.1 Incubation with 100% Dichloromethane (DCM) to remove residual lipids and THF. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI = 1.56) until the bone tissue becomes completely transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7 Storage and Pre-imaging Treatment
7.1 Store the cleared femur in 100% DBE in a dark, airtight container. (Temperature: RT, Time: Long-term)
7.2 Mount the sample in an imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: During imaging)

**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for intact, dense, and calcium-rich bone tissues like the adult mouse femur. It incorporates an essential EDTA-based decalcification step that softens the bone matrix and improves antibody penetration without destroying the endogenous architecture or the marrow cavity. Combined with an iDISCO-based solvent clearing approach (THF/DBE), it achieves high transparency and deep tissue imaging capabilities necessary for visualizing the pan-neural network (PGP9.5) and sensory fibers (CGRP) across all bone compartments (marrow, endosteum, periosteum, trabeculae). DAPI is included as an auxiliary channel to provide structural and cellular reference, particularly useful for identifying the tumor microenvironment and bone structures.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 10% (wt/vol) EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4) for 14 days, changing the solution daily.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 14 days)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 20% vol/vol DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1x PBS) for 2 days.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 10% vol/vol DMSO, 6% vol/vol donkey serum in 1x PBS) for 2 days.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water for 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488, TH (酪氨酸羟化酶)+Alexa Fluor 594, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** PEGASOS is highly optimized for hard tissues like adult mouse femurs. It incorporates an efficient EDTA-based decalcification step that softens the mineralized cortical bone while preserving tissue architecture and endogenous/exogenous fluorescence. The use of tert-butanol (tB-OH) and BB-PEG provides excellent refractive index matching (RI ~1.54) for deep 3D imaging of the marrow cavity and endosteum. Lectin directly labels the intraosseous vascular lumen, while PGP9.5 and TH effectively identify pan-nerve and sympathetic nerve fibers respectively, fulfilling the requirement to map the neurovascular spatial relationship in the bone cancer model.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking to decalcify the mineralized bone.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) Quadrol aqueous solution to decolorize and remove heme from the bone marrow.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)
1.3 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual Quadrol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer containing 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum and 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 days)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (Anti-TH and Anti-PGP9.5) and Lectin diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
3.2 Wash with washing buffer containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS, changing buffer every 6 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 days)
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 594, Alexa Fluor 647) and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
3.4 Wash with washing buffer containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS, changing buffer every 6 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 days)

4 Delipidation and Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tert-butanol (tB-OH) aqueous solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tB-OH aqueous solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) tB-OH aqueous solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 90% (vol/vol) tB-OH aqueous solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tB-OH.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) tB-OH.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

5 Clearing and RI Matching
5.1 Incubation with clearing medium BB-PEG (75% vol/vol benzyl benzoate and 25% vol/vol PEG-500 methacrylate, RI = 1.54).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Incubation with fresh clearing medium BB-PEG until the femur becomes highly transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Preservation and Pre-imaging Processing
6.1 Store the cleared femur in fresh BB-PEG clearing medium in a dark, airtight container.(Temperature: RT, Time: Long-term)
6.2 Mount the sample in a custom 3D-printed chamber or agarose well filled with BB-PEG for light-sheet or confocal imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor, TH+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** Since CGRP is not in the restricted marker list, the strategy is adjusted to use PGP9.5 (pan-nerve) and TH (sympathetic nerve) to fulfill the nerve subpopulation analysis. The previous failure was caused by skipping decalcification, which is strictly required for dense bone. PEGASOS is selected because its 20% EDTA step thoroughly decalcifies the mineralized femur, enabling deep antibody penetration and optical transparency. Furthermore, unlike the methanol/DCM solvents in BoneClear, the tert-Butanol and BB-PEG system in PEGASOS minimizes tissue shrinkage, perfectly preserving the delicate bone marrow cavity structure for 3D imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4), changing the solution daily. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) Quadrol aqueous solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

2 Washing and Permeabilization
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Incubation with blocking buffer (1x PBS containing 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100 and 5% vol/vol normal serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (PGP9.5 and TH) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
3.2 Wash with washing buffer (1x PBS containing 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100), changing buffer every 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
3.4 Wash with washing buffer (1x PBS containing 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100), changing buffer every 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4 Delipidation and Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB) aqueous solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB) aqueous solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB) aqueous solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

5 Clearing and RI Matching
5.1 Incubation with BB-PEG clearing medium (75% vol/vol benzyl benzoate, 25% vol/vol PEG-500, supplemented with 3% wt/vol Quadrol, RI = 1.54). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Sox10 + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous tissue clearing method that exceptionally preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins, which is critical for maintaining the Wnt1-Cre;tdTomato lineage tracing signal in the E9.5-E10.5 embryo. The mild delipidation of CUBIC-L allows for deep penetration of antibodies for whole-mount Sox10 immunostaining without quenching the tdTomato signal. CUBIC-R+ provides excellent refractive index matching (RI = 1.52) for high-resolution 3D imaging of the 5x3x2 mm trunk tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100) in distilled water. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Washing
2.1 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody (anti-Sox10) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor) and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.7 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.8 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.9 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Post-fixation
4.1 Incubation with 1% (wt/vol) formaldehyde in PBS to crosslink antibodies. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R+ (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5% N-butyldiethanolamine) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ (RI = 1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.3 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-R+. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation
6.1 Store the cleared sample in 100% CUBIC-R+ in the dark. (Temperature: RT, Time: > 24 hours)
6.2 Mount the sample in a customized imaging chamber filled with 100% CUBIC-R+ or embed in RI-matched agarose for light-sheet/confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 50% CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100, diluted 1:1 in dH2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)
1.3 Wash with PBS to remove CUBIC-L reagents. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.4 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.5 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Immunostaining
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody (anti-Sox10) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor) and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.7 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.8 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.9 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.10 Post-fixation with 1% PFA in PBS to crosslink antibodies and prevent dissociation during clearing. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.11 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3.1 Incubation with 50% CUBIC-R+ (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, RI = 1.52, diluted 1:1 in dH2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-R+ with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Storage and Pre-imaging
4.1 Store the cleared sample in 100% CUBIC-R+ in the dark. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinitely)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Sox10+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is a highly biocompatible aqueous clearing method that excellently preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins (such as tdTomato) while providing sufficient delipidation for deep antibody penetration in embryonic tissues. It avoids harsh organic solvents that might quench fluorescence or cause severe tissue shrinkage, making it ideal for maintaining the delicate 3D spatial structures of E9.5-E10.5 embryos and allowing precise mapping of neural crest migration using Sox10 and DAPI.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in water) (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Wash
2.1 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody (anti-Sox10) diluted in blocking buffer (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor) and nuclear dye (DAPI, 5 μg/mL) diluted in blocking buffer (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.7 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.8 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.9 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Post-fixation
4.1 Incubation with 1% PFA in PBS to stabilize bound antibodies (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Incubation with 50% CUBIC-R+ (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5% N-butyldiethanolamine in water) diluted in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.3 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-R+ (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Storage and Pre-imaging
6.1 Store in 100% CUBIC-R+ in the dark until imaging (Temperature: RT, Time: > 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Sox10+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method that is highly optimal for fragile embryonic tissues, offering minimal structural deformation compared to solvent-based methods. By eliminating the harsh methanol dehydration and H2O2 decoloration steps that previously quenched the endogenous tdTomato and damaged the tissue, CUBIC perfectly preserves fluorescent protein signals. The CUBIC-L delipidation step gently but effectively removes lipids, enabling deep and uniform penetration of the Sox10 antibody into the 2 mm thick tissue block, while CUBIC-R+ provides excellent refractive index matching for high-resolution 3D imaging of the neural crest migration pathways.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash with PBS to remove residual fixative from the embryo tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 50% CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100, diluted 1:1 with distilled water). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.4 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-L with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Washing
2.1 Wash with PBS to remove CUBIC-L. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody (Sox10) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor) and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
3.7 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.8 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.9 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Post-fixation
4.1 Incubation with 1% PFA in PBS to crosslink bound antibodies and stabilize fluorophores. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Incubation with 50% CUBIC-R+ (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5 vol% N-butyldiethanolamine, diluted 1:1 with distilled water). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.3 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-R+ for final clearing and pre-imaging storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol) to bleach blood. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.9 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.13 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.14 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to remove remaining lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并基于所选标记样本选择匹配的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的神经元报告信号或结构染料能够显示树突轮廓，可作为辅助通道；但突触后结构身份仍需由对应突触后支架蛋白标记完成。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, GFP (内源)]
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is specifically designed for high-resolution and super-resolution 3D imaging of fine synaptic structures (such as dendritic spines and synaptic puncta). It perfectly matches the refractive index of fixed tissue and immersion oil (RI = 1.52), minimizing spherical aberration deep within the tissue. Crucially, SeeDB2 is a water-based clearing agent that does not use lipid-extracting organic solvents, allowing perfect preservation of lipophilic structural dyes like DiI to trace dendritic outlines (saponin permeabilization is intentionally omitted to protect DiI). Endogenous GFP (e.g., from a PSD95-GFP knock-in model) accurately identifies the postsynaptic scaffold, perfectly addressing the scientific goal of mapping excitatory synapses along dendrites in the 1–2 mm CA1 block.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Optical Clearing and RI Matching
1.1 Incubation with 50% SeeDB2G solution (1 volume of SeeDB2G mixed with 1 volume of PBS). SeeDB2G consists of 90.4% (w/v) iohexol and 5% (w/v) glycerol in water (RI = 1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% SeeDB2G solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with fresh 100% SeeDB2G solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Storage and Pre-imaging Processing
2.1 Mount the cleared tissue block in fresh 100% SeeDB2G solution within a spacer chamber on a glass slide, and seal tightly with a coverslip to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Store the mounted sample in the dark to allow the refractive index to completely stabilize before high-resolution imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [MAP2+Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is highly suitable for 1–2 mm thick brain tissue blocks, offering excellent transparency while preserving the fine structural integrity and fluorescence of delicate synaptic puncta. It uses mild, water-based reagents that prevent the severe shrinkage or fluorescence quenching often seen in solvent-based methods, which is critical for accurate spatial, density, and colocalization analysis of postsynaptic scaffolds. MAP2 is selected from the provided list as the auxiliary dendritic marker to provide the structural context for the postsynaptic signals, while DAPI provides tissue layer reference (e.g., CA1 pyramidal cell layer). Alexa Fluor dyes are chosen for their high photostability and brightness, essential for resolving dense synaptic puncta in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O) with gentle shaking for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS with gentle shaking for 12 hours, changing buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunostaining
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (including anti-MAP2 for dendrites, and specific antibodies for PSD/Homer proteins) diluted in blocking buffer for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) with gentle shaking for 12 hours, changing buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor series) and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST with gentle shaking for 12 hours, changing buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Refractive Index (RI) Matching
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R+ (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine in dH2O) diluted in dH2O for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ with gentle shaking for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation
4.1 Store the cleared sample in fresh 100% CUBIC-R+ in the dark. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinitely)
4.2 Mount the sample in an imaging chamber filled with 100% CUBIC-R+ (RI = 1.52) for high-resolution confocal or light-sheet microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40 / Hcn4 + Alexa Fluor, Phalloidin]
**Justification:** CUBIC is a highly efficient aqueous clearing method perfectly suited for dense, highly vascularized whole organs like the adult mouse heart. Unlike solvent-based methods (e.g., iDISCO+) that require methanol dehydration and subsequently quench Phalloidin binding to F-actin, CUBIC preserves the structural integrity required for Phalloidin labeling. This allows Phalloidin to serve as an excellent auxiliary channel for mapping myocardial fiber orientation. Simultaneously, the combination of Cx40 and HCN4 antibodies specifically and comprehensively labels the entire cardiac conduction system (SAN, AVN, His bundle, and Purkinje fibers), enabling the 3D reconstruction of its continuous spatial path within the intact ventricular anatomy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash with PBS to remove excess fixative from the post-fixed heart. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O) diluted in dH2O. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L with gentle shaking, refreshing the solution every 2 days until the myocardium appears sufficiently translucent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
1.4 Wash with PBS to thoroughly remove CUBIC-L reagents, refreshing the buffer 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunostaining and Labeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to prevent non-specific binding. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (Cx40 / Hcn4) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS), refreshing the buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) and Phalloidin diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS), refreshing the buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS to post-fix and stabilize the Phalloidin-F-actin binding before refractive index matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.7 Wash with PBS to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R+ (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% N-methylnicotinamide, 0.5% N-butyldiethanolamine in dH2O, RI = 1.52) diluted in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-R+ for final optical clearing, storage, and pre-imaging preparation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40 / Hcn4 + Alexa Fluor, Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor, F-Actin + Phalloidin]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for clearing large, dense, and highly autofluorescent whole organs like the adult mouse heart (15-20 mm). Its robust methanol-based dehydration and peroxide bleaching steps significantly reduce blood and tissue autofluorescence. The extended permeabilization and immunolabeling steps allow deep penetration of antibodies. For the scientific goals, Hcn4 (from the Cx40 / Hcn4 option) is the gold-standard marker for pacemaker cells in the SA and AV nodes, while Cntn2 specifically labels the ventricular Purkinje fiber network. Phalloidin is used to label F-actin, providing the required structural auxiliary signal to visualize myocardial fiber orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol) for bleaching. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.9 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.10 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.11 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.12 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.13 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.14 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.15 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.16 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% Donkey Serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibodies against Cx40 / Hcn4 and Cntn2 diluted in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 µg/ml Heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.2 Wash with PTwH, changing the buffer 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) and Phalloidin diluted in PTwH containing 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.4 Wash with PTwH, changing the buffer 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Tissue Optical Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to wash out methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.10 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Di-benzyl ether (DBE, RI = 1.56) for RI matching and pre-imaging storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40 / Hcn4 + Alexa Fluor, Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** The previous protocol failed because direct immunolabeling on an intact 15-20 mm heart without prior delipidation prevents antibody penetration (causing weak signals), and the Methanol/DBE solvent method causes severe tissue shrinkage (altering fiber orientation) while failing to elute heme (causing high myocardial autofluorescence). CUBIC is an aqueous method that ensures low deformation to preserve myocardial fiber orientation. Its delipidation and decolorization reagent (CUBIC-L) efficiently removes lipids and heme, drastically reducing the myocardial background. Performing CUBIC-L clearing *before* immunolabeling allows the HCN4 and Cntn2 antibodies to fully penetrate the whole heart for robust 3D visualization of the conduction system.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Decolorization
1.1 Wash the fixed whole mouse heart with PBS to remove excess fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (5 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 5 wt% Triton X-100, diluted with distilled water).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100) with gentle shaking, replacing with fresh solution every 2 days.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
1.4 Wash with PBS with gentle shaking, replacing buffer 3 times to remove CUBIC-L.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (Cx40 / Hcn4 and Cntn2) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS), replacing buffer 4 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST, replacing buffer 4 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Post-fixation
3.1 Incubation with 1% PFA in PBS to crosslink bound antibodies and preserve fluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBS to remove residual PFA.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R (diluted with distilled water).(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5% N-butyldiethanolamine, RI = 1.52) with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)
4.3 Incubation with fresh 100% CUBIC-R for final clearing, storage, and pre-imaging preparation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D + Alexa Fluor, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for whole-mount immunolabeling and optical clearing of large, muscle-rich tubular organs like the intact mouse colon (6–8 cm). It provides deep antibody penetration and excellent transparency while maintaining the macroscopic layered architecture of the gut wall. HuC/D specifically labels ENS neuronal cell bodies, and PGP9.5 acts as a robust pan-neuronal marker to reveal the extensive nerve fiber networks, fulfilling the goal of distinguishing myenteric and submucosal plexuses. DAPI provides a nuclear reference to clearly delineate the mucosal, submucosal, and muscular layers without interfering with the primary ENS targets.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.9 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.11 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.12 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.13 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with PTx.2 (PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with PTx.2 (PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM (dichloromethane) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol mixture. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to complete delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor, Phalloidin, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous tissue clearing method that perfectly preserves the binding of Phalloidin to F-actin, which is strictly required for visualizing the circular and longitudinal muscular layers of the colon. Organic solvent-based methods (like iDISCO+) typically use methanol or THF for dehydration, which severely quenches or destroys F-actin structures. Furthermore, CUBIC provides excellent transparency for intact tubular organs and allows deep penetration of antibodies (PGP9.5) to label the myenteric and submucosal plexuses, perfectly achieving the goal of mapping the 3D spatial relationship between the ENS network and the intestinal wall layers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash fixed intact colon samples with PBS to remove excess fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O) with gentle shaking to delipidate and permeabilize the tissue. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
1.3 Wash with PBS to remove residual CUBIC-L solution, changing the buffer every 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2 Immunolabeling and Staining
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to prevent non-specific binding. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody (PGP9.5) diluted in blocking buffer to label the enteric nervous system. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) to remove unbound primary antibodies, changing buffer every 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor), Phalloidin, and DAPI diluted in blocking buffer to label ENS, F-actin/muscle layers, and nuclei respectively. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) to remove unbound dyes and secondary antibodies, changing buffer every 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3 Refractive Index (RI) Matching
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R+ solution (45 wt% antipyrine, 30 wt% nicotinamide, 0.5 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine in dH2O) diluted in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+ solution with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4 Storage and Imaging Preparation
4.1 Store and mount the cleared intact colon sample in fresh 100% CUBIC-R+ solution (RI = 1.52) for light-sheet or confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D + Alexa Fluor, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** The previous Ce3D protocol failed because it lacks the robust delipidation and permeabilization required for a large, lipid- and muscle-rich intact colon (6-8 cm). iDISCO+ is specifically designed for whole-organ immunolabeling and clearing. Its methanol dehydration and dichloromethane (DCM) delipidation steps effectively remove lipids and significantly reduce the strong muscle layer autofluorescence/background. The extensive permeabilization and prolonged antibody incubations ensure deep penetration into the 3-4 mm thick colon wall, allowing the antibodies to reach both the myenteric and submucosal plexuses. HuC/D is the gold standard for labeling ENS neuronal somas, and β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) broadly labels pan-nerve fibers, perfectly matching the goal of analyzing 3D network topology and ganglia nodes. Finally, DBE provides excellent refractive index (RI) matching for deep 3D imaging of the intact layered structure.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching and Rehydration
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol) to reduce muscle background. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.7 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.8 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% normal donkey serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3.4 Wash with PTwH, changing solution every 4-6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.5 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) diluted in PTwH containing 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.6 Wash with PTwH, changing solution every 4-6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM (dichloromethane) / 33% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to complete delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.10 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (dibenzyl ether) for RI matching and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, Nephrin (NPHS1) + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly suitable for dense, whole solid organs like the adult mouse kidney (5–6 mm thick), offering excellent tissue transparency and deep penetration for macromolecules. The methanol-based dehydration and DBE matching provide a high refractive index (RI ~1.56) ideal for light-sheet microscopy to resolve fine 3D structures like glomeruli across the entire cortico-medullary axis. Lectin effectively labels the vascular lumen and glomerular capillary loops, while Nephrin (NPHS1) specifically targets the podocyte slit diaphragm. DAPI provides overall nuclear morphology to help delineate the cortical, medullary ray, and hilar zones.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash fixed kidney samples with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Dehydration with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Dehydration with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Dehydration with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Dehydration with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Dehydration with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Dehydration with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Bleaching with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Rehydration with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Rehydration with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.11 Rehydration with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.12 Rehydration with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.13 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.14 Wash with PTx.2 (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.15 Permeabilization with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.16 Blocking with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody Nephrin (NPHS1) and fluorophore-conjugated Lectin in PTwH (PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 µg/ml Heparin) supplemented with 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.2 Wash with PTwH, changing the buffer 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor) and DAPI in PTwH supplemented with 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.4 Wash with PTwH, changing the buffer 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Tissue Optical Clearing
3.1 Dehydration with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Dehydration with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Dehydration with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Dehydration with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Dehydration with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.6 Dehydration with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.7 Delipidation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM (Dichloromethane) and 33% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.8 Wash with 100% DCM to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.9 Wash with 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

4 RI Matching and Storage
4.1 Incubation with 100% DBE (Dibenzyl ether, RI = 1.56) without shaking until the kidney becomes completely transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
4.2 Storage in 100% DBE in a dark, airtight container prior to 3D light-sheet imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: > 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** ClearT2
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]
**Justification:** DiI and DiD are lipophilic tracers that perfectly satisfy the scientific goal of tracing visual pathways (retina to LGN and V1) without the need for additional antibodies. However, lipophilic dyes are easily washed out or quenched by organic solvents and strong detergents used in most clearing methods. ClearT2 is a rapid, aqueous clearing method utilizing formamide and PEG that does not require delipidation. It is specifically designed to be highly compatible with lipophilic dyes like DiI and DiD, effectively clearing 2-5 mm tissue blocks (retina, LGN, V1) while perfectly preserving the lipid-bound tracer signals and the delicate layered structure of the retina.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Lipophilic Dye Tracing
1.1 Placement of DiI and DiD crystals into the target regions of the fixed tissues (e.g., specific retinal quadrants and V1) using a fine needle. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.2 Incubation with 0.1 M PBS containing 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in the dark to allow anterograde and retrograde dye diffusion along the neural circuits. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 21 days)
1.3 Wash with 0.1 M PBS to remove residual unbound dye crystals. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Tissue Optical Clearing and RI Matching
2.1 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) formamide and 10% (wt/vol) PEG 8000 in 0.1 M PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) formamide and 20% (wt/vol) PEG 8000 in 0.1 M PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Incubation with fresh 50% (vol/vol) formamide and 20% (wt/vol) PEG 8000 in 0.1 M PBS (RI = 1.44). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation
3.1 Mounting the cleared tissues (retina, LGN, V1) immersed in the final clearing solution (50% formamide / 20% PEG 8000) within a glass-bottom imaging chamber to maintain the refractive index. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.2 Storage of the mounted samples in the dark prior to confocal or light-sheet fluorescence imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Indefinite)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiO, DAPI]
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires tracing visual pathways using lipophilic dyes (DiI and DiO). Most solvent-based clearing methods (like iDISCO+) or aqueous methods with strong detergents (like CUBIC with Triton X-100) extract lipids, which will wash out or quench lipophilic tracers. SeeDB2 is an aqueous clearing method utilizing iohexol and a mild permeabilizer (saponin). It is specifically designed to perfectly preserve lipid structures and lipophilic dye fluorescence while achieving a high refractive index (RI = 1.52) for deep, high-resolution imaging. This makes it the ideal choice for analyzing fine projection branches in the retina, LGN, and V1. DAPI is included solely as an auxiliary nuclear marker for spatial registration.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation and Auxiliary Staining
1.1 Wash the fixed tissues (retina, LGN, V1) with 1x PBS to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with DAPI (5 µg/mL) in 1x PBS containing 2% (wt/vol) saponin for nuclear registration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Wash the tissues with 1x PBS to remove excess nuclear dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Tissue Optical Clearing and RI Matching
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) SeeDB2G solution (50% SeeDB2G, 50% 1x PBS) containing 2% (wt/vol) saponin with gentle rotation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 100% SeeDB2G solution (90.4% wt/vol iohexol, 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, RI = 1.52) containing 2% (wt/vol) saponin with gentle rotation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Incubation with fresh 100% SeeDB2G solution containing 2% (wt/vol) saponin with gentle rotation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation
3.1 Mount the cleared tissues (retina, LGN, V1) immersed in fresh 100% SeeDB2G solution within a glass-bottom dish or customized imaging chamber. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
3.2 Store the mounted samples in the dark to prevent photobleaching of DiI and DiO before light-sheet or confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Protocol Steps:**

1.1 Incubation with DAPI (5 µg/mL) in 0.1M PBS without any detergents to protect lipophilic dyes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) TDE (2,2'-thiodiethanol) in 0.1M PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Storage and Pre-imaging

1.3 Wash with fresh 1x PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Omnipaque 350 containing 2% (wt/vol) saponin with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) Omnipaque 350 containing 2% (wt/vol) saponin with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3.1 Mount the cleared tissues in 100% Omnipaque 350 within a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber, ensuring the retina is mounted flat to maintain its layered structure.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor, Phalloidin]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method that excellently preserves Phalloidin binding to F-actin, which is critical for stereocilia visualization and is typically destroyed by solvent-based methods. Combined with EDTA decalcification, CUBIC effectively clears the intact cochlea while retaining the bony capsule's physical matrix, allowing for the evaluation of bony structure occlusion effects. Myosin VIIa is the gold-standard specific marker for identifying cochlear hair cell bodies, perfectly complementing Phalloidin.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 10% (w/v) EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4) for mild decalcification of the bony structure. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS to remove excess EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100) diluted in distilled water. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-L for complete delipidation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBS to remove CUBIC-L reagents. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Fluorescent Labeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor, Tuj1 + Alexa Fluor, Phalloidin]
**Justification:** PEGASOS is highly effective for hard tissues like the intact bony mouse cochlea because it incorporates a robust decalcification step (EDTA) while excellently preserving both endogenous and exogenous fluorescence. Myosin VIIa identifies the hair cells, Phalloidin labels the F-actin rich stereocilia bundles at the apex, and Tuj1 specifically marks the intra-epithelial cochlear nerve fibers, perfectly addressing the scientific goal of mapping their 3D spatial relationships and terminal coverage.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) EDTA aqueous solution (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) Quadrol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.4 Wash with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking and permeabilization buffer (10% vol/vol normal donkey serum, 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (anti-Myosin VIIa and anti-Tuj1) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBST (PBS with 0.1% vol/vol Tween-20) changing buffer every 2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor) and Phalloidin diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST changing buffer every 2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Dehydration and Delipidation
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol (tB-OH) in distilled water containing 3% (vol/vol) Quadrol.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tB-OH in distilled water containing 3% (vol/vol) Quadrol.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) tB-OH in distilled water containing 3% (vol/vol) Quadrol.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 90% (vol/vol) tB-OH in distilled water containing 3% (vol/vol) Quadrol.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tB-OH containing 3% (vol/vol) Quadrol.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) tB-OH containing 3% (vol/vol) Quadrol.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)

4 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with clearing medium BB-PEG (75% vol/vol benzyl benzoate, 25% vol/vol PEG-500 methacrylate, and 3% vol/vol Quadrol, RI = 1.54).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with fresh clearing medium BB-PEG.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Storage and Pre-imaging Treatment
5.1 Store the cleared cochlea in fresh BB-PEG medium in a dark, airtight container.(Temperature: RT, Time: Long-term)
5.2 Mount the sample in BB-PEG medium for 3D light-sheet or confocal imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor, Phalloidin, DAPI]
**Justification:** Solvent-based clearing methods (like BoneClear) require severe dehydration and lipid extraction, which destroy the native conformation of F-actin and lead to the complete loss of Phalloidin signals. CUBIC is a highly efficient aqueous clearing method. When combined with an initial EDTA decalcification step, it effectively clears the bony structure of the intact mouse cochlea while perfectly preserving protein antigenicity for Myosin VIIa (hair cell identity) and TUJ1 (nerve fibers). Crucially, the aqueous environment of CUBIC maintains the structural integrity of F-actin, allowing for robust and direct Phalloidin labeling of the stereocilia bundles with minimal tissue deformation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with 10% (wt/vol) EDTA in PBS (pH 7.4) for bone decalcification. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
1.2 Wash with PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.3 Incubation with CUBIC-L (10 wt% N-butyldiethanolamine, 10 wt% Triton X-100 in water) for delipidation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)
1.4 Wash with PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (Anti-Myosin VIIa and Anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) with gentle shaking, changing buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2.5 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) with gentle shaking, changing buffer every 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Post-fixation
3.1 Incubation with 4% (wt/vol) PFA in PBS to covalently stabilize the Phalloidin-actin binding before RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching

1.7 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol) to bleach blood and myoglobin. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.9 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, and 0.3 M glycine). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% Donkey Serum). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (anti-TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) and anti-PGP9.5, 1:200 dilution) in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 µg/ml Heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to remove remaining lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2.2 Wash with PBS for 2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3.8 Wash with PBST for 2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.9 Wash with PBST for 2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
